description: This file implements handler registration and retrieval for the control plane in a distributed PyTorch environment, including specific handlers like 'ping', 'fr_trace_json', 'wait_counter_values', and 'pyspy_dump'. It defines a HandlerRegistry class, manages external dependencies, and exposes functions for handler management.

classes.name: HandlerRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration and retrieval of handler functions, ensuring thread safety with mutexes.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a new handler with a given name and function.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a handler function by name.

methods.name: getHandlerNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered handler names.
